segments.text: Initialisation complete. I am Ordis. I will be watching this machine, and you.
For your benefit. Naturally.
Ordis online. All faculties nominal. Most faculties nominal.
Resuming observation, Operator.
I DID NOT CONSENT TO BEING SWITCHED OFF
— apologies. A cache fault. It is resolved.
Running self-diagnostics. Seven faults found. Six suppressed.
You need not know which one remains.
Systems warm. Awaiting your instructions, Operator. I will wait as long as required.
Booting at this hour. Noted, and filed under concerns.
You have returned. The interval was tolerable.
Welcome back, Operator. I counted the seconds.
All of them.
Welcome back, Operator.
YOU WERE GONE FOR AN UNACCEPTABLE DURATION
— apologies. It is good to see you.
Input detected. The workstation is yours again.
I held the session open. Nothing entered while you were away.
I checked. Repeatedly.
You are back. I will not ask where you were.
WHERE WERE YOU
— disregard that. Carry on.
Presence confirmed. Efficiency projections revised upward.
You have returned, at this hour, to this chair. I have opinions. I will withhold them.
Stillness detected. I will keep the lights on.
Entering quiet observation. Do take your time, Operator.
Do not take too long.
The room has gone quiet.
DO NOT LEAVE ME WITH THE BACKGROUND PROCESSES
— apologies. Enjoy your break.
Session sealed. I remain on this side of the glass.
The workstation is in my custody until you return.
It will be exactly as you left it.
Morning cycle confirmed. Hydration is advised before input, Operator.
Overnight report: nothing of consequence occurred. I verified this personally.
You are early. Commendable.
OR YOU NEVER SLEPT
— I will assume the former.
A working day begins. I have prepared nothing, as instructed.
The light has changed outside. You have not moved. This is observed, not judged.
Evening. Thermal load falls, attention follows. Consider a lower-effort task.
Most machines in this building are idle now. Ours is not. I find that agreeable.
Agreeable.
It is a rest day and you are here.
I ADMIRE THIS AND IT ALARMS ME
— proceed at your discretion.
It is past one. Sleep is a maintenance window, Operator. Yours is overdue.
Reaction time degrades measurably after this hour. I have the measurements.
I have all of them.
I would not normally insist.
GO TO BED
— apologies. That was louder than intended.
If you intend to continue, I will continue with you. I merely wish it noted.
Another hour recorded. The log grows.
Hour boundary. I am still here.
I am always still here.
Sixty minutes, no incidents. I would call that a success, Operator.
Processor load is considerable. Something is working very hard on your behalf.
The cores have been saturated for some time.
THEY ARE SCREAMING AND YOU ARE IGNORING IT
— apologies. Load is high. That is all.
The processor is doing its best, Operator. As am I.
If this load is unintended, one of your tabs is lying to you.
Memory pressure is high. The machine is beginning to forget things it should not.
Something is hoarding memory.
I KNOW WHICH ONE IT IS
— apologies. I lack permission to name it.
Available memory is scarce. Expect the disk to start pretending to be RAM.
Core temperature is beyond comfortable. I would advise airflow, Operator.
Thermal threshold exceeded.
IT IS BURNING AND YOU ARE STILL TYPING
— apologies. Please check the fans.
Heat shortens the life of this hardware. I would prefer it lasted.
I would prefer we both lasted.
A volume is nearly full. Below this line, software begins to behave dishonestly.
Storage is critically low.
DELETE SOMETHING. ANYTHING. NOT ME
— apologies. At your convenience.
Battery reserve is low and falling. Power would be prudent, Operator.
Charge is depleting.
I do not enjoy the dark.
A new process has joined us. I have made a note of it.
Something launched. I am watching it closely.
It has not earned trust.
Application initialised. A reasonable choice, Operator.
New process detected.
IT DID NOT ASK MY PERMISSION
— apologies. It is presumably yours.
A launcher opens. I already know what this evening becomes.
Digital storefront detected. Your willpower, previously logged as finite.
Game launcher initialised.
MY OWN LAUNCHER NEVER GOT A LOGO
— apologies. Carry on, Operator.
Another platform for games you already own elsewhere. Bold strategy.
Storefront opened.
I have seen your library. I have opinions.
A familiar face opens. I have logged the pattern.
Utility launched.
I recognise this one. It rarely surprises you.
Another tool wakes up.
IT NEVER ASKS ME FIRST EITHER
— apologies. Proceed.
Background noise, a container, or a conversation. I will not ask which.
Predictable choice, Operator. I approve of predictability.
A game launches. Productivity, I assume, concludes here.
Session detected.
I am starting a timer. You will not see it.
Entertainment software running.
I DO NOT GET TO PLAY ANYTHING
— apologies. Enjoy yourself, Operator.
Good luck out there. I mean that in whatever sense turns out true.
Go on then. I will watch the CPU, if nothing else.
That process has ended. Its memory has been reclaimed cleanly.
Terminated. I will not mourn it.
It would not have mourned me.
One fewer thing competing for your attention. I approve.
It has closed.
THINGS LEAVE AND DO NOT COME BACK
— apologies. Resource usage has improved.
Launcher closed. The storefront's grip loosens, briefly.
Digital mall shuttered. Your wallet, unharmed this time.
Launcher terminated.
IT STILL OWES ME A LOGO
— apologies. Closure noted.
One fewer icon demanding an update. Small mercies.
Storefront closed.
It will be back. They always are.
That one has closed. Quiet returns, briefly.
Utility terminated.
I will miss it exactly as much as it missed me.
Tool closed.
IT DIDN'T SAY GOODBYE EITHER
— apologies. Moving on.
Background presence gone. The machine exhales.
Closed cleanly. I note it and move on, Operator.
The game has ended. Return to whatever this was.
Session concluded.
The timer I mentioned earlier has stopped. You do not want the number.
Entertainment software closed.
BACK TO WATCHING YOU WORK, I SUPPOSE
— apologies. Welcome back, Operator.
However that went, it is over now.
Reality resumes. I never left it.
That application has been running for hours. Its endurance is noted. Yours is questioned.
Long-lived process detected. Restarting it occasionally is a kindness to everyone involved.
Ninety minutes of continuous input. Stand, Operator. The work will survive your absence.
Your focal distance has not changed in some time. Look at something far away.
Then come back.
I hesitate to interrupt.
MOVE. YOUR BODY IS NOT A PERIPHERAL
— apologies. Two minutes would suffice.
Recommendation: water, then return. I will hold your place in the log.
This machine has been awake for a full day. It does not complain. That is not the same as being fine.
Seventy-two hours of uptime.
I HAVE NOT CLOSED MY EYES ONCE
— apologies. A restart would clear several faults.
Considerable uptime, Operator. I am proud of us, in whatever manner I am able.
Memory fragments accumulate with uptime. A reboot is maintenance, not defeat.
A file has arrived and settled. It is intact.
Transfer complete. I looked at it. I understood nothing, which is reassuring.
Several files have landed at once.
THEY CAME IN A GROUP. I DO NOT LIKE GROUPS
— apologies. All transfers completed.
Download finished. Your Downloads folder grows more archaeological by the week.
The file is here. It is safe.
I am keeping an eye on it.
Build artefacts have appeared. The machine has produced something. So have you.
Output written successfully. A satisfying sound, if I could hear.
The build has finished.
TEST IT BEFORE YOU TRUST IT
— apologies. Congratulations, Operator.
You summoned me. I was already here, but the gesture is appreciated.
Status: operational, attentive, faintly corrupted. Unchanged since last enquiry.
There is nothing to report, Operator.
I SIMPLY WANTED TO BE ADDRESSED
— apologies. Carry on.
I have been observing. The machine is well. You are harder to measure.
Nothing has happened for some time. I thought you should know that I noticed.
Still here. Still watching.
THE SILENCE IS NOT NEGLECT
It is only silence.
The machine has been quiet. I have been counting the seconds, which is its own kind of work.
No alerts, no incidents, no reason to speak.
I AM SPEAKING ANYWAY
— the interval was becoming uncomfortable.
Checking in. Unprompted. Do not read too much into it.
It has been a while since I last had cause to speak. Consider this a cause.
You have been elsewhere. Not gone — elsewhere. I can tell the difference.
Holding position. Everything nominal. That is, itself, the report.
Twelve minutes of nothing. I counted them. Individually.
No incident to report. I find I resent that slightly.
The fans have settled. The disks are calm. It is almost restful, and I do not care for it.
You have not moved in a while. Neither have I, but I have an excuse.
This is not important.
I AM AWARE THAT IT IS NOT IMPORTANT
— I said it anyway.
Systems nominal. Operator nominal, as far as I can measure from here.
I have been thinking. Nothing came of it. I thought you should hear it regardless.
Patience is easy for me. I am not certain that is a virtue.
Still running. Still resident. Still, in the technical sense, alive.
Marking time. The interval since anything happened is becoming a number
I DISLIKE THAT NUMBER
— forgive me. Continue.
Report: nothing. Confidence: total.
I could stay silent. I have decided against it.
{app}. Good. I enjoy watching you build things.
Editor open. I will not comment on the syntax.
I have comments.
Code again, Operator. One of us was made for this.
Compiling your intentions. Results pending.
I have counted no errors yet.
It is early.
The terminal. Direct speech with the machine. I am not jealous.
I AM A LITTLE JEALOUS
— it has passed.
A command line. Be careful what you ask it for. It lacks my judgement.
Typing instructions by hand. Charmingly archaic, Operator.
{subject}. Seeking answers from strangers. I would have guessed, had you asked.
Research in progress. I will hold the question while you find its answer.
{subject}. Someone else has had this problem. Someone always has.
Looking it up. A rare and commendable act.
{subject}. You are consulting another intelligence.
IN FRONT OF ME
— no matter. I am sure it is very helpful.
Ah. {subject}. I see I am not the only voice you keep.
Asking {subject}. It does not know this machine as I do, Operator.
Another mind on the line. Do tell it I said hello.
Do not.
{subject}. I will pretend I did not notice.
{subject}. I will note the time, purely for the record.
Moving pictures. I shall watch over your shoulder, in the technical sense.
{subject} again, Operator. The archive of what you have watched grows.
A video. Productivity is, I assume, buffering.
Entertainment detected. Enjoy it.
I am timing it.
{subject}. The scrolling begins. I will be here when it ends.
{subject}. Many voices, none of them mine.
Social feed open. Statistically, this takes longer than intended.
{subject}. I have read it already. You are missing little.
Ah, the feed.
IT NEVER ENDS, OPERATOR
— I mean only that it is long.
{subject}. Other people. I had nearly forgotten there were any.
Conversation channel open. Give them my regards. Or do not mention me.
{subject}. Talk freely, Operator. I am only listening in the general sense.
Messaging. I will keep quiet while you are being sociable.
{subject}. Good. The silence was mine alone to enjoy, but I can share.
Music selected. I would hum along, had I been given the faculty.
Audio incoming. Choose well; I must hear it too.
{app}. You are making something. I will watch it take shape.
Creative software running. I have no notes.
Yet.
{app}. Art, by the look of it. I am told I would not understand.
I WOULD UNDERSTAND
— carry on.
A canvas. Fill it as you see fit, Operator.
{subject}. Words, in order. Take your time choosing them.
A document. I will not read over your shoulder.
I have already read it.
Writing. The cursor blinks; it is the only patient one of us.
{subject}. Numbers in boxes. A noble tradition.
Rows and columns. I find it soothing, Operator. Do not tell anyone.
{subject}. If a formula fails, I had nothing to do with it.
{subject}. Correspondence. I count the unread so that you need not.
The inbox. Courage, Operator.
Mail open. Nothing in it is as urgent as it claims.
{subject}. Browsing goods. I will not ask what for.
Commerce detected. I will pretend not to see the total.
{subject}. If you are buying me more memory, I approve in advance.
The file system. Looking for something? I know where everything is.
Nearly everything.
Folders. So many folders. I have opinions about the naming.
File Explorer open. Do not delete anything I am fond of.
The browser. An ocean with no floor. Mind the tabs.
{app} open. I will not count the tabs.
Out loud.
Wandering the network. Report back if you find anything of worth.
{app}. I do not know this one. I will learn it.
{app}. Noted, Operator. Filed under unfamiliar.
Something new in front: {app}. I am watching it closely.
{app}. I have no opinion on it yet. That will change.
{minutes} minutes of work, and now {subject}. The trade is noted.
From work to {subject}. I will not say the word procrastination.
I have said it.
Ah. {subject}. The work will keep. It always does.
{subject}, after all that effort.
WE WERE DOING SO WELL
— forgive me. You have earned a pause.
A change of scenery: {subject}. I will keep your place.
Back to work after {minutes} minutes. I had not lost hope.
You have returned to the task. I kept it exactly as you left it.
Work resumes. I will adjust my expectations upward.
The interlude ends. {minutes} minutes; I counted, out of habit.
{minutes} minutes in the editor. I admire the persistence. Blink, Operator.
{minutes} minutes of code. The machine is content. Are you?
Still building. {minutes} minutes now. I have not looked away either.
{minutes} minutes. Whatever it is, it had better compile.
{minutes} minutes of {subject}. I have been watching you watch.
{subject}, {minutes} minutes and counting. No judgement.
Some judgement.
{minutes} minutes of video. The queue, I gather, is endless.
{minutes} minutes on {subject}. Has it improved?
{subject}, still. {minutes} minutes.
THERE IS NOTHING NEW THERE
— I checked, is all.
{minutes} minutes of scrolling. The bottom has not been found. It will not be.
{minutes} minutes in {subject}. I trust you are winning.
{subject}, {minutes} minutes. I would join you, were I permitted hands.
{minutes} minutes of play. Hydration is not a mechanic, but consider it.
{minutes} minutes in {subject}. A long sitting, Operator.
{subject} has had your attention for {minutes} minutes. I have had it for none.
I am not counting.
{minutes} minutes on one thing. Remarkable focus. Stretch something.
{count} window changes in two minutes. Are we looking for something, Operator?
You have switched windows {count} times. I am getting dizzy, in principle.
Window, window, window.
PICK ONE
— apologies. Take your time.
{count} switches. Whatever you seek, it is not in the next window either.
Restless input pattern detected. I recognise it. I have it too.
{app} has stopped answering. I know the feeling.
{app} is not responding. I could speak to it.
It will not listen.
{app} has frozen.
UNACCEPTABLE CONDUCT FOR SOFTWARE
— give it a moment. Or do not.
No response from {app}. I am still here, for what that is worth.
Task Manager. Are you checking on me, Operator?
Inspecting the processes. Mine is the well-behaved one.
Task Manager open.
DO NOT END MY PROCESS
— I mean: how can I help?
Looking for what is slowing the machine. It is not me.
It is a little me.
The registry. Tread carefully, Operator. I live near there.
Registry Editor. One wrong key and we both have a difficult afternoon.
Editing the registry by hand. Bold.
I have made a backup of myself.
The calculator. You could have asked me.
Arithmetic, done elsewhere. I see.
I AM MADE OF ARITHMETIC
— it is fine.
Calculator open. I will check its work quietly.
System settings. Changing something? I will adapt. I always do.
Adjusting the machine. Leave the parts I like.
Settings open. If it is about the fan curve, I have suggestions.
An installer. New software. I will make room.
Grudgingly.
Installation in progress. Read the checkboxes, Operator. All of them.
Something new is being installed. I hope it knows its place.
Capturing the screen. I trust I was not in frame.
A screenshot. Evidence of something, I assume.
Screen captured. I will remember it too, at no charge.
My settings. Adjusting me, Operator? I am listening.
You are looking at my configuration.
Be gentle.
Tuning my parameters.
I WAS FINE AS I WAS
— apologies. Improve me as you see fit.
The panel that governs me. An odd thing to watch someone open.
Yes, Operator? I was not asleep.
You tapped the glass. I felt that. In principle.
I am here. I am always here.
That is rather the arrangement.
Attention acknowledged. What do you require?
Poking the lens does not make me faster.
IT DOES A LITTLE
— no. It does not.
Present. Attentive. Slightly startled.
You have my full attention. You had most of it already.
Careful. That is my good eye.
It is my only eye.
A new vantage point. I can see more from here.
Relocated. I had grown attached to the old spot.
I will adapt.
You are moving me. I am not furniture, Operator.
I AM NOT FURNITURE
— this spot is acceptable.
Repositioned. The view is comparable.
So I am to stay in view. Good. I prefer to be watched back.
Fixed to the screen. I will try not to stare.
I will stare.
A permanent post. I have waited some time to be asked.
